title: groupGone can spin the full 2 s on every deadline/overflow rejection when orphaned group members are zombies awaiting a slow reaper (container PID 1 without init), and the bound expiry is silent
evidence: Reasoned from Linux semantics, not reproduced (no Linux here). kill(-pgid,0) succeeds while any group member, including an unreaped zombie, exists. After SIGKILL the grandchild is reparented to init/subreaper. docker-compose.yml has no init:true / tini, and node as PID 1 does not reap arbitrary orphans, so a zombie would persist and groupGone would poll 200 times then return, adding 2000 ms to every deadline/overflow rejection and holding removeEphemeral behind it. On expiry it still rejects with the original error (correct) but logs nothing. Separately the bare catch treats EPERM as gone (does not hang; only reachable if a group member changed uid).
fix_direction: Treat a group whose members are all state Z as gone (scan /proc on linux), or catch err.code==="ESRCH" only and give up on EPERM explicitly; emit one log/metric line when the bound is hit; add init:true to the compose api service. File-dont-fix per round cap (non-security).
